page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (left side), a few short references and marks beside the lines. Running head at top, page number at top.

main_text.p: * Johannes I. cognomento † Africanus, * Petrus, † Silverius, * Vigilius, † Pelagius, Iohannes III, cognomento * Catellinus. Bonifacius IIII, Cuius Diofcorus oppofitus erat, coacta Romae ... Baron. T. 7. Diofcori affeclas excommunicare voluit, Vigilii ... um fibi fuccelforem deftinavit; fed opponentibus fe Senatoribus, tententiam fuam revocavit. Idem Michaeli Archangelo erectum in Hadriani ... Procop. bell. templum dedicasse dicitur. Sub Iohanne ... Vandal. ii. quondam a Tyro Hierofolymitanis erepta, ... Iudaeorum Hierofolymam translata fuit, & ... Cedrenus. zarbus, Rex iberorum, Conftantinopoli baptizatus ... Niceph. l. 17. tus eft. Agapetus, Conftantinopolim a Theodorico ... c. 19. hato, ut pacem componeret, miflus, Anthimum ... Episcopum, haereticos deprehenfum ... Anaftaf. in Synodo, Epifcopatu dejecit, & Mennam ... Vita Pete. tuit; Augufto vero indignanti, putat ... Christianissimum Principem Iustinianum ... nunc autem Diocletianum inveni, relictum ... Silverius, à Theodahato per vim ... ... celilario, juffu Augustae, quod Anthimum ... Oriens. Vigilius uere nollet, exaudoratus * eft, Vigilius ... quam Anthimum reftitutionem promifit. ... ficatum obtinuit, & cum fide tradita ... nem Imperatoris interdixit, & ... rum fubitituerctur, metueret, fibi a Belisario ... ditum, in Palmeriam infulam deportari jussus. Caranza in Concil. Sub eo feftum Hypapantes feu purificationis ... iuini. * inftitutum, in tertia Aurelianiifi ... neá die Coenae Domini, per totum ... triduum Christiani fele Iudaeis immilcere, aut ... bem quoquo modo circumire liceret, lancinis ... in celebratione Paichae apud Orientem ...

page.notes: Page is badly damaged and faded; many words in the right-hand portion and marginal notes are illegible and were transcribed only approximately or left with ellipses where unreadable. Marginal notes are mostly partial. Some readings are doubtful and should be checked against the scan.
